**The census supports closing a judge-only re-send, but not the broader claim that no paid Stage B send could exercise the control line.** The result page needs corrections before D576 records it.

I checked the stored control answers and the draw stores. The reported **seven eligible, four with the required material shown** matches the original count; all four agree with reader B. I also checked the cited revenue-growth and memory-spending records in the stores: they are present and unlinked. The census omits one repeat, u3/e135, although it too is unlinked. [Control count]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/result/control-count.txt:1), [census]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/stage-b-controls/CENSUS.md:25).

The corrections that matter are:

- **“Up to 10” is not established by the stated repairs.** Starting at four, the one additional ladder case and the three currently eligible cases missing material give **eight**, assuming every proposed change works. The other two potential controls also lack material and need their own traced changes and eligibility decisions. Eight would exercise the line; it would not by itself pass it, which also requires all but one counted answer to agree. [Census]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/stage-b-controls/CENSUS.md:38), [Stage B rule]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/STAGE_B_READING.md:87).

- **The ladder-only “at most five” is a conditional paper bound**, not a demonstrated outcome of a re-send. It assumes the existing material-exposure marks remain applicable after changed questions, dates and judging requests. The classification also simplifies the earlier trace: u1/clean-6’s 2028 period was already in the opened thesis; u3/clean-5’s opening already included actual sales; and u1/clean-11’s ladder wording was disputed. Those are mixed or unresolved causes, not three cleanly attributable cases. [Prior control trace]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/CONTROL_TRACE.md:19).

- For the missing q04 statement, “not found in the stored draw” does not alone establish **an extraction failure**. The earlier trace says whether its source article was read was not traced. Check that article’s input and raw output before assigning the loss. [Control trace]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/CONTROL_TRACE.md:30).

- The **12-of-15** agreement includes differently worded questions. It is a descriptive overlap with the reference, not evidence that those twelve answers are correct. Nor does the line measure only opening and filing: it also checks the judge’s agreement once eligibility and delivery are met. The four counted cases alone cannot establish judge quality. [Census output]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/stage-b-controls/control-census.txt:1), [Stage B rule]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/STAGE_B_READING.md:84).

I agree **no unchanged judge-only paid re-send** should be proposed on these fixed inputs: it cannot change which questions and material were supplied. Do not close all future Stage B testing on that basis. Any changed upstream version or altered measurement population needs its own reviewed design and decision, including the restriction on further paid tests against the frozen ruler. [New-system frame]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/NEW-SYSTEM-FRAME.md:13).

For Alex’s page, I would add: **“The final-answer test could compare only four questions with the reference because the other questions or the facts shown did not meet its control conditions; eight were required.”** That does not imply the judge passed or failed on the excluded questions.

There is **no demonstrated intervention on the record that can move a gate now**. Its falsifier is that the facts were unavailable, do not bear on the actual questions, fail to reach the right requests, or the same mechanism adds wrong material. This prepares a possible product change; it does **not** pass Stage B or justify a paid send. The earlier delivery test was inconclusive, so the check must explain what new mechanism or evidence it adds rather than simply repeat it. [D456]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:5054), [D511]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:5935).
